## Posted terms
Title: Platform Support Engineer, Developer Tools
Company: a mid-size B2B software company
Location: Remote (US)
Type: Full time
Salary: $135,000-$160,000 + equity

## Job description (as posted)

**About the role**
Our developer platform has grown faster than the team supporting it, and the backlog of
customer-reported issues is real and growing. We are hiring a Platform Support Engineer to
own the technical side of that: reproduce what customers report, fix what you can, and
route what you can't with enough detail that engineering doesn't have to start over.

**Responsibilities**
- Reproduce and diagnose customer-reported issues against our API, SDKs and CLI
- Fix bugs you can fix; write the reproduction and the diagnosis for the ones you can't
- Own the escalation path into engineering, including the on-call handoff
- Keep the troubleshooting documentation current as the platform ships
- Feed recurring issues back to product as a prioritized list, with volume attached

**Required**
- 3+ years supporting or building against a developer-facing API or SDK
- Comfortable reading and writing Python or TypeScript well enough to reproduce a bug
  and propose the fix
- Can hold a technical conversation with a frustrated engineer on the customer side
- Experience working an on-call rotation

**Nice to have**
- Experience with our stack (Postgres, Kubernetes, Terraform)
- Prior work at a company selling to developers
- Written public technical documentation or troubleshooting guides
